bio: Tea & Tales Afternoon Tea at St Martins Lane is available from 18th October 2023  St Martins Lane London, the boutique, five-star hotel where elegant and edgy meets decadent, is inviting guests to experience its brand-new Afternoon Tea offering Tea & Tales at St Martins Lane. The delectable menu has been crafted especially to tell the unique tale of St Martins Lane and the unique artwork featured in The Den. The menu takes inspiration from the hotel’s striking spaces, designed by French designer Phillippe Starck who fashioned the site to create a surreal wonderland of classic Britain, with a dash of eccentricity.  Indulge in delights such as Revolving Door - Croque Monsieur with Honey Roasted Ham and Goat Cheese; Game of Chess - Opera Cake with Kalamansi; and Cricket Ball - a Yuzu Cheesecake with Cherry Glaze.  As part of the Afternoon Tea Menu, guests also receive a map of the space’s unique art display, elevating the tea to be a fully immersive experience.  In the heart of the vibra nt West End in London's Covent Garden, St Martins Lane London is a stunning design-led lifestyle hotel, only minutes from the Royal Opera House, Trafalgar Square, and the main shopping district.  St Martins Lane London was awarded a Commended certificate at the Afternoon Tea Awards 2019 in recognition of its high-quality Afternoon Tea service.
